instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: CanopyHarbor Inspection Referral brief: The objective is to record public-tree concerns, document inspection findings, and refer recommended intervention to a responsible service team. Residents report concerns with the tree location and observed issue. Service Intake Officers record service priorities. Field Inspectors record tree conditions and intervention recommendations. Works Coordinators create action referrals only when intervention is recommended and record responsible service teams. Resident Liaisons send inspection outcomes to Residents. Work on private-property trees and emergency dispatch are outside the project. The priority rule, service-team selection rule, and outcome delivery channel are undecided.

output.business_objective: Record public-tree concerns, document inspection findings, and refer recommended intervention to a responsible service team.
